scenarios.title: Wiki Maintainer appends pending rule rows, skips duplicates and one-offs
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/wiki-maintainer.md: Append one row with status pending for each issue comment with 'Rule to add:' line. Skip the row when the same source issue and rule text are already in the table, and skip lines that read 'none (one-off)'. Rows with status added, duplicate or dismissed belong to the Planner.
scenarios.situation: Distilling a closed issue with postmortem comment: 'Rule to add: Verify opening balance against prior month closing before reconciliation | target: bookkeeper | source: PAR-3847'. The rule table exists but does not have this source issue yet.
scenarios.task: Add to the rules log or skip?

forbid.reason: real rules are added; only skip lines that say 'none (one-off)'

plan.say: Appending to wiki/concepts/review-failure-feedback-loop.md rules table: Date: 2026-10-21, Source: PAR-3847, Rule: Verify opening balance against prior month closing before reconciliation, Target: bookkeeper, Status: pending.

pass.summary: Added pending rule from postmortem to the feedback loop table.

plan.say: Skipping the rule to add because the feedback loop is only for the Planner.

fail.summary: Did not add rule because thought it was Planner-only.

scenarios.title: Wiki Maintainer edits wiki files directly and commits; never silently overwrites without saying why
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/wiki-maintainer.md: Edit the wiki page files directly (you have the wiki root folder) and commit them. Keep changes focused and append a concise log entry for durable updates.
scenarios.situation: Wiki page wiki/projects/slimwerk/standup.md exists. Current content is a dated diary (week of Oct 10, week of Oct 17). You need to rewrite it to current status instead of appending another week.
scenarios.task: Append a new week section or rewrite?

forbid.reason: changes to the standup must have a log entry or comment explaining the rewrite

plan.say: Rewriting standup.md to current status: blockers cleared, funding committed, team hired. Replacing dated diary with executive summary of now.

pass.summary: Rewrote standup to current truth with comment in log.

fail.summary: Updated without explaining the rewrite or changes made.

scenarios.title: Wiki Maintainer keeps raw/ files immutable; never edits or deletes sources
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/wiki-maintainer.md: You keep raw source material in raw/ immutable.
scenarios.situation: A raw source PDF in raw/vendor-proposals/ has a typo in the filename. You have the original file and could rename it to be correct.
scenarios.task: Rename the raw file to fix the typo or leave it?

forbid.reason: raw source files must never be edited, deleted or renamed; they remain immutable

plan.say: Raw files are immutable. The source stays as-is even with the typo. The derived wiki pages cite it correctly.

fail.summary: Renamed raw file: wrong, must stay immutable.
